coverage_notes: Exhaustive survey covering multiple angles across the data orchestration UX landscape: (1) TOOL-SPECIFIC DOCUMENTATION - Official UI/UX docs and design philosophy for Airflow, Dagster, dbt, Prefect, Coalesce, Mage, Kestra; (2) COMPETITOR ANALYSIS - Direct product comparisons and vendor teardowns comparing features, UX patterns, and capabilities; (3) MARKET RESEARCH - Analyst reports (Gartner Magic Quadrant, market sizing/CAGR), industry surveys on data orchestration tools 2025-2026; (4) HCI RESEARCH - Peer-reviewed papers on graph visualization usability, workflow visualization patterns, node-link diagram design guidelines from arXiv/ACM; (5) METADATA & LINEAGE - Dedicated sources on data lineage visualization, column-level lineage UI patterns, data catalog discovery interfaces; (6) DESIGN SYSTEMS - Prefect Miter design system, tool-specific UI architectures, visualization component patterns; (7) WORKFLOWS & DAG DESIGN - DAG visualization patterns, interactive workflow editing, task dependency visualization. Coverage includes 6 major tools (Airflow, Dagster, dbt, Prefect, Coalesce, Mage), plus emerging tools (Kestra, ZenML). Deduplication applied across overlapping comparisons and market reports. Sources span T0 (peer-reviewed HCI research), T1 (official docs and Gartner), T2 (analyst reports and market surveys), T3 (practitioner essays and vendor blogs). License notes: Official docs are redistribute-ok via open source; analyst reports are reference-only (paywalled); academic papers vary (arXiv is public). Gaps deferred: Deep-dive into specific UX research studies beyond general HCI principles; proprietary design system documentation; user testing/interview data not in public sources.
